  ↑fp.length = uint.Z b.index' ∧ PlogWf base0 fp ∧ plogLast base0 fp = b

def CampOk (T : w64) (F : List EntryM) : Prop :=
  PlogWf base0 F ∧ ∀ (j x : w64), plogTermAt base0 F j = some x → uint.Z x < uint.Z T

    uint.Z j → plogTermAt b (es ++ es2) j = (fun e => e.Term') <$> es2[(uint.Z j - plogLastIndexZ b
    es - 1).toNat]?

    pending := r.pending ++ [q], acks := <[id := w64Max ((r.acks !! id).getD (W64 0)) (r.confirmed +
    W64 ↑(r.pending ++ [q]).length)]>r.acks, confirmed := r.confirmed }

def AppOk (id : w64) (s : PState) (m : Msg) : Prop :=
  m.ty = MsgType.app ∧
    m.src = id ∧
      m.term = s.term ∧
        m.dst ≠ id ∧
          plogTermAt s.base s.log m.index = some m.logterm ∧
            uint.Z m.commit ≤ uint.Z s.commit ∧
              (∀ (e : EntryM), e ∈ m.entries → e ∈ s.log) ∧
                m.entries <+: plogFrom s.base s.log (m.index + W64 1) ∧ AppPayloadOk m

inductive MsgType : Type
  | MsgType.vote : MsgType
  | MsgType.voteResp : MsgType
  | MsgType.app : MsgType
  | MsgType.appResp : MsgType
  | MsgType.heartbeat : MsgType
  | MsgType.heartbeatResp : MsgType
  | MsgType.propose : MsgType
  | MsgType.snap : MsgType
  | MsgType.preVote : MsgType
  | MsgType.preVoteResp : MsgType
  | MsgType.readIndex : MsgType
  | MsgType.readIndexResp : MsgType

  if uint.Z y < uint.Z x then x else y

    Nat) (e : EntryM) (Hwf : PlogWf prev ents) (Hm : PlogMatches b es prev) (Hd : ents[d]? = some e)
    (Hbefore : ∀ (j : Nat) (e' : EntryM), j < d → ents[j]? = some e' → PlogMatches b es (entId e'))
    : uint.Z e.Index' ≤ plogLastIndexZ b es + 1

def pleaderEntry (s : PState) : EntryM :=
  stamp s.term (plastIndex s) 0 (zero_val EntryM)

def MsgType.ofNat : Nat → MsgType :=
  bif n.ble 5 then
    bif n.ble 2 then bif n.ble 0 then MsgType.vote else bif n.ble 1 then MsgType.voteResp else MsgType.app
    else bif n.ble 3 then MsgType.appResp else bif n.ble 4 then MsgType.heartbeat else MsgType.heartbeatResp
  else
    bif n.ble 8 then bif n.ble 6 then MsgType.propose else bif n.ble 7 then MsgType.snap else MsgType.preVote
    else bif n.ble 9 then MsgType.preVoteResp else bif n.ble 10 then MsgType.readIndex else MsgType.readIndexResp

  ents : List EntryM

    base0 (List.take n F) j = plogTermAt base0 F j

    log := s.log ++ es, commit := s.commit, matched := s.matched, rd := s.rd }

    ∧ uint.Z j ≤ plogLastIndexZ b es → (plogTermAt b es j).isSome = true

def preadRespondAll (id : w64) (s : PState) (qs : List ReadReq) : PState :=
  List.foldl (preadRespond id) s qs

theorem plogMaybeAppend_inv (b : entryID) (es : List EntryM) (prev : entryID) (ents : List EntryM)
    (lastnewi : w64) (es' : List EntryM) : PlogWf prev ents → uint.Z prev.index' + ↑ents.length + 1
    < 2 ^ 64 → plogMaybeAppend b es prev ents = some (lastnewi, es') → PlogMatches b es prev ∧
    uint.Z lastnewi = uint.Z prev.index' + ↑ents.length ∧ ((es' = es ∧ ∀ (k : Nat) (e : EntryM),
    ents[k]? = some e → PlogMatches b es (entId e)) ∨ ∃ d e, ents[d]? = some e ∧ ¬PlogMatches b es
    (entId e) ∧ (∀ (k : Nat) (e' : EntryM), k < d → ents[k]? = some e' → PlogMatches b es (entId
    e')) ∧ uint.Z e.Index' = uint.Z prev.index' + ↑d + 1 ∧ uint.Z e.Index' ≤ plogLastIndexZ b es + 1
    ∧ es' = List.take (uint.Z e.Index' - uint.Z b.index' - 1).toNat es ++ List.drop d ents)

def readonlyAdvance (r : ReadOnly) (N : w64) : ReadOnly × List ReadReq :=
  if uint.Z N ≤ uint.Z r.confirmed then (r, [])
  else
    have k := uint.nat (N - r.confirmed);
    ({ pending := List.drop k r.pending, acks := r.acks, confirmed := N }, List.take k r.pending)

    some e) (h : l1 <+: l2) : l2[k]? = some e

    x ∈ q2

def RecsAgree (b1 : entryID) (es1 : List EntryM) (b2 : entryID) (es2 : List EntryM) : Prop :=
  ∀ (k1 k2 : Nat) (e1 e2 : EntryM),
    es1[k1]? = some e1 →
      es2[k2]? = some e2 →
        uint.Z b1.index' + ↑k1 + 1 < 2 ^ 64 →
          uint.Z b2.index' + ↑k2 + 1 < 2 ^ 64 →
            e1.Term' = e2.Term' →
              e1.Index' = e2.Index' → e1 = e2 ∧ plogTermAt b1 es1 (pidx b1 k1) = plogTermAt b2 es2 (pidx b2 k2)

def fromLeader : MsgType → Bool :=
  match x✝ with
  | MsgType.app => true
  | MsgType.heartbeat => true
  | MsgType.snap => true
  | x => false

def HeartbeatOk (id : w64) (s : PState) (m : Msg) : Prop :=
  m.ty = MsgType.heartbeat ∧
    m.src = id ∧
      m.term = s.term ∧ m.dst ≠ id ∧ uint.Z m.commit ≤ uint.Z s.commit ∧ uint.Z m.commit ≤ uint.Z (matchOf s m.dst)

def PlogWfR (b : entryID) (es : List EntryM) : Prop :=
  ∀ (k : Nat) (e : EntryM),
    es[k]? = some e → uint.Z b.index' + ↑k + 1 < 2 ^ 64 → uint.Z e.Index' = uint.Z b.index' + ↑k + 1

def padoptLeader (s : PState) (src : w64) : PState :=
  { term := s.term, vote := s.vote, lead := src, role := Role.follower, votes := ∅, outbox := s.outbox, base := s.base,
    log := s.log, commit := s.commit, matched := ∅, rd := s.rd }

theorem full_term_at_some (F : List EntryM) (j k : w64) : (plogTermAt base0 F k).isSome = true →
    uint.Z j ≤ uint.Z k → (plogTermAt base0 F j).isSome = true

theorem readonlyPosition_le (r : ReadOnly) : uint.nat (readonlyPosition r) ≤ uint.nat r.confirmed +
    r.pending.length

theorem plogFindConflict.eq_def (b : entryID) (es x✝ : List EntryM) : plogFindConflict b es x✝ =
    match x✝ with | [] => W64 0 | e :: ents' => if PlogMatches b es (entId e) then plogFindConflict
    b es ents' else e.Index'

theorem preadRespondAll_nil (id : w64) (s : PState) : preadRespondAll id s [] = s

def pidx (b : entryID) (k : Nat) : w64 :=
  W64 (uint.Z b.index' + ↑k)

def firstOcc (ods : List (Option (List w8))) : List (List w8) :=
  List.foldl occStep [] ods

def preadRespond (id : w64) (s : PState) (q : ReadReq) : PState :=
  if q.src = W64 0 ∨ q.src = id then
    match q.ents with
    | e :: tail =>
      { term := s.term, vote := s.vote, lead := s.lead, role := s.role, votes := s.votes, outbox := s.outbox,
        base := s.base, log := s.log, commit := s.commit, matched := s.matched,
        rd :=
          have __src := s.rd;
          { states := s.rd.states ++ [{ Index' := q.index, RequestCtx' := e.Data' }], ro := __src.ro,
            pend := __src.pend } }
    | [] => s
  else psendMsgs s [Msg.mk MsgType.readIndexResp id q.src s.term false q.index (W64 0) (W64 0) (W64 0) q.ents]

def pbecomeFollower (s : PState) (term lead : w64) : PState :=
  { term := term, vote := if term = s.term then s.vote else W64 0, lead := lead, role := Role.follower, votes := ∅,
    outbox := s.outbox, base := s.base, log := s.log, commit := s.commit, matched := ∅, rd := rdNL s.rd }

def recordVote (votes : GMap w64 Bool) (src : w64) (v : Bool) : GMap w64 Bool :=
  match votes !! src with
  | some val => votes
  | none => <[src := v]>votes

def instEmptyCollectionCSLists : EmptyCollection CSLists :=
  { emptyCollection := { voters := [], learners := [], outgoing := [], learnersNext := [] } }

theorem plogMaybeAppend_last (b : entryID) (es : List EntryM) (prev : entryID) (ents : List EntryM)
    (lastnewi : w64) (es' : List EntryM) : PlogWf prev ents → uint.Z prev.index' + ↑ents.length + 1
    < 2 ^ 64 → plogMaybeAppend b es prev ents = some (lastnewi, es') → uint.Z lastnewi ≤
    plogLastIndexZ b es'

def instDecidableEqCSLists.decEq (x✝ x✝¹ : CSLists) : Decidable (x✝ = x✝¹) :=
  match x✝¹, x✝ with
  | { voters := a, learners := a_1, outgoing := a_2, learnersNext := a_3 },
    { voters := b, learners := b_1, outgoing := b_2, learnersNext := b_3 } =>
    if h : a = b then
      h ▸
        if h : a_1 = b_1 then
          h ▸ if h : a_2 = b_2 then h ▸ if h : a_3 = b_3 then h ▸ isTrue ⋯ else isFalse ⋯ else isFalse ⋯
        else isFalse ⋯
    else isFalse ⋯

def hbCtx (r : ReadOnly) : List w8 :=
  if r.pending = [] then [] else u64Le (readonlyPosition r)

def Msg.plain (ty : MsgType) (src dst term : w64) (reject : Bool) : Msg :=
  Msg.mk ty src dst term reject (W64 0) (W64 0) (W64 0) (W64 0) []

def RejHintOk (b : entryID) (l : List EntryM) (index logterm hint : w64) : Prop :=
  uint.Z hint ≤ uint.Z index ∧
    (1 ≤ uint.Z index →
      1 ≤ plogLastIndexZ b l →
        (∀ (t0 : w64), plogTermAt b l (W64 1) = some t0 → uint.Z t0 ≤ uint.Z logterm) → 1 ≤ uint.Z hint)

def LeaderMatchOk (id : w64) (s : PState) (mt : GMap w64 w64) : Prop :=

def CSWf (vo v l ln : List w64) : Prop :=
  v ≠ [] ∧
    (∀ (x : w64), x ∈ vo ∨ x ∈ v ∨ x ∈ l ∨ x ∈ ln → x ≠ W64 0) ∧
      (∀ (x : w64), x ∈ l → ¬x ∈ v ∧ ¬x ∈ vo) ∧ (∀ (x : w64), x ∈ ln → x ∈ vo ∧ ¬x ∈ v ∧ ¬x ∈ l) ∧ (vo = [] → ln = [])

theorem plog_cut_keep (b : entryID) (es : List EntryM) (ci : Int) (ents2 : List EntryM) (j : w64) :
    uint.Z b.index' < ci ∧ ci ≤ plogLastIndexZ b es + 1 → uint.Z j < ci → plogTermAt b (List.take
    (ci - uint.Z b.index' - 1).toNat es ++ ents2) j = plogTermAt b es j

theorem plogTermAt_take (b : entryID) (es : List EntryM) (n : Nat) (j : w64) : uint.Z j ≤ uint.Z
    b.index' + ↑n → plogTermAt b (List.take n es) j = plogTermAt b es j

theorem readonlyRelease_shape (r : ReadOnly) (id c : w64) (l : List (MessageM × List EntryM)) :
    (readonlyRelease r id c l).confirmed = r.confirmed ∧ (readonlyRelease r id c l).pending.length =
    r.pending.length + l.length

theorem plogMaybeAppend_batch (b : entryID) (es : List EntryM) (prev : entryID) (ents : List EntryM)
    (lastnewi : w64) (es' : List EntryM) : PlogWf prev ents → uint.Z prev.index' + ↑ents.length + 1
    < 2 ^ 64 → plogMaybeAppend b es prev ents = some (lastnewi, es') → ∀ (j : w64), uint.Z
    prev.index' ≤ uint.Z j → uint.Z j ≤ uint.Z prev.index' + ↑ents.length → plogTermAt b es' j =
    plogTermAt prev ents j

def HbCtxOk (r : ReadOnly) (ctx : List w8) : Prop :=
  ctx = [] ∨ ∃ q, ctx = u64Le q ∧ uint.nat q ≤ uint.nat r.confirmed + r.pending.length

theorem plogFindConflict_zero (b : entryID) (es ents : List EntryM) : (∀ (k : Nat) (e : EntryM),
    ents[k]? = some e → e.Index' ≠ W64 0) → plogFindConflict b es ents = W64 0 → ∀ (k : Nat) (e :
    EntryM), ents[k]? = some e → PlogMatches b es (entId e)

def pselfAck (id : w64) (s : PState) : Msg :=
  Msg.mk MsgType.appResp id id s.term false (plastIndex s) (W64 0) (W64 0) (W64 0) []

theorem full_last (b : entryID) (fp es : List EntryM) : FullOk b fp → plogLast base0 (fp ++ es) =
    plogLast b es

def readonlyRelease (r : ReadOnly) (id c : w64) (pend : List (MessageM × List EntryM)) : ReadOnly :=
  List.foldl (fun r p => readonlyArrive r id { index := c, src := p.fst.From', ents := p.snd }) r pend

def plastIndex (s : PState) : w64 :=
  W64 (plogLastIndexZ s.base s.log)

def w64Min (x y : w64) : w64 :=
  if uint.Z x < uint.Z y then x else y

theorem app_payload_from_log (b : entryID) (L : List EntryM) (t i : w64) (es : List EntryM) : PlogWf
    b L → uint.Z b.index' + ↑L.length + 1 < 2 ^ 64 → uint.Z b.index' ≤ uint.Z i ∧ uint.Z i ≤
    plogLastIndexZ b L → es <+: plogFrom b L (i + W64 1) → PlogWf { term' := t, index' := i } es ∧
    uint.Z i + ↑es.length + 1 < 2 ^ 64

theorem full_term_at (b : entryID) (fp es : List EntryM) (j : w64) : FullOk b fp → uint.Z b.index' ≤
    uint.Z j → plogTermAt base0 (fp ++ es) j = plogTermAt b es j

theorem HbCtxOk_mono (r r' : ReadOnly) (ctx : List w8) : r'.confirmed = r.confirmed →
    r.pending.length ≤ r'.pending.length → HbCtxOk r ctx → HbCtxOk r' ctx

def ReplOk (id : w64) (s : PState) (m : Msg) : Prop :=
  AppOk id s m ∨ SnapOk id s m

theorem pappend.proj_rd (s : PState) (es : List EntryM) : (pappend s es).rd = s.rd

def rejected (votes : GMap w64 Bool) : GSet w64 :=
  (GMap.filter (fun x v => !v) votes).domSet

def ackedBy (s : PState) (n : w64) : GSet w64 :=
  (GMap.filter (fun x x_1 => decide (uint.Z n ≤ uint.Z x_1)) s.matched).domSet

structure SnapTrip : Type where
  sid : entryID
  cl : CSLists
  al : Bool
  dat : List w8

theorem readonlyAdvance_acks (r : ReadOnly) (a : GMap w64 w64) (N : w64) : readonlyAdvance { pending
    := r.pending, acks := a, confirmed := r.confirmed } N = if uint.Z N ≤ uint.Z r.confirmed then ({
    pending := r.pending, acks := a, confirmed := r.confirmed }, []) else ({ pending := List.drop
    (uint.nat (N - r.confirmed)) r.pending, acks := a, confirmed := N }, List.take (uint.nat (N -
    r.confirmed)) r.pending)

inductive Role : Type
  | Role.follower : Role
  | Role.candidate : Role
  | Role.leader : Role

theorem nodup_foldl_occStep (L : List (List w8)) (b : List (Option (List w8))) : L.Nodup →
    (List.foldl occStep L b).Nodup

def msgSnapTrip (m : Msg) : SnapTrip :=
  { sid := { term' := m.logterm, index' := m.index }, cl := m.cl, al := m.al, dat := [] }

theorem rdNL_ite (c : Prop) [Decidable c] (rd : RdState) : rdNL (if c then rd else rdNL rd) = rdNL
    rd

def pbecomeCandidate (id : w64) (s : PState) : PState :=
  { term := s.term + W64 1, vote := id, lead := W64 0, role := Role.candidate, votes := ∅, outbox := s.outbox,
    base := s.base, log := s.log, commit := s.commit, matched := ∅, rd := rdNL s.rd }

def occStep (L : List (List w8)) : Option (List w8) → List (List w8) :=
  match x✝ with
  | none => L
  | some d => if d ∈ L then L else L ++ [d]

def instInhabitedRole : Inhabited Role :=
  { default := instInhabitedRole.default }

def readonlyPosition (r : ReadOnly) : w64 :=
  r.confirmed + W64 ↑r.pending.length

def PCanVote (s : PState) (src : w64) : Prop :=
  s.vote = src ∨ s.vote = W64 0 ∧ s.lead = W64 0

structure PState : Type where
  term : w64
  vote : w64
  lead : w64
  role : Role
  votes : GMap w64 Bool
  outbox : List Msg
  base : entryID
  log : List EntryM
  commit : w64
  matched : GMap w64 w64
  rd : RdState

theorem plog_cut_last (b : entryID) (es : List EntryM) (ci : Int) (ents2 : List EntryM) : uint.Z
    b.index' < ci ∧ ci ≤ plogLastIndexZ b es + 1 → plogLastIndexZ b (List.take (ci - uint.Z b.index'
    - 1).toNat es ++ ents2) = ci - 1 + ↑ents2.length

structure ReadOnly : Type where
  pending : List ReadReq
  acks : GMap w64 w64
  confirmed : w64

theorem padoptLeader.proj_rd (s : PState) (src : w64) : (padoptLeader s src).rd = s.rd

theorem w64Max_spec (x y : w64) : uint.Z (w64Max x y) = max (uint.Z x) (uint.Z y)

theorem psendMsgs_outbox (s : PState) (ms : List Msg) : (psendMsgs s ms).outbox = s.outbox ++ ms

theorem psendMsgs.proj_role (s : PState) (ms : List Msg) : (psendMsgs s ms).role = s.role

theorem firstOcc_nodup (ods : List (Option (List w8))) : (firstOcc ods).Nodup

theorem batch_index_nz (prev : entryID) (ents : List EntryM) (Hwf : PlogWf prev ents) (k : Nat) (e :
    EntryM) : ents[k]? = some e → e.Index' ≠ W64 0

theorem batch_lookup (prev : entryID) (ents : List EntryM) (j : w64) : PlogWf prev ents → uint.Z
    prev.index' < uint.Z j ∧ uint.Z j ≤ uint.Z prev.index' + ↑ents.length → ∃ x, ents[(uint.Z j -
    uint.Z prev.index' - 1).toNat]? = some x ∧ x.Index' = j ∧ plogTermAt prev ents j = some x.Term'

theorem pappend.proj_commit (s : PState) (es : List EntryM) : (pappend s es).commit = s.commit

def matchOf (s : PState) (v : w64) : w64 :=
  (s.matched !! v).getD (W64 0)

theorem plog_prefix_batch (bL : entryID) (l : List EntryM) (prev : entryID) (ents : List EntryM) :
    uint.Z prev.index' + ↑ents.length + 1 < 2 ^ 64 → plogTermAt bL l prev.index' = some prev.term' →
    ents <+: plogFrom bL l (prev.index' + W64 1) → ∀ (j : w64), uint.Z prev.index' ≤ uint.Z j →
    uint.Z j ≤ uint.Z prev.index' + ↑ents.length → plogTermAt bL l j = plogTermAt prev ents j

def CSLists.Has (cl : CSLists) (id : w64) : Prop :=
  id ∈ cl.voters ∨ id ∈ cl.learners ∨ id ∈ cl.outgoing

theorem psendMsgs.proj_log (s : PState) (ms : List Msg) : (psendMsgs s ms).log = s.log

def FollowerVotesOk (s : PState) : Prop :=
  s.role = Role.follower → s.votes = ∅

theorem pappend.proj_base (s : PState) (es : List EntryM) : (pappend s es).base = s.base

def PtOk (F0 : List EntryM) (T : w64) (k : Int) (pt : w64) : Prop :=
  plogLastIndexZ base0 F0 < k ∧
    uint.Z pt ≤ uint.Z T ∧
      (k = plogLastIndexZ base0 F0 + 1 → pt = (plogLast base0 F0).term') ∧ (plogLastIndexZ base0 F0 + 1 < k → pt = T)

def base0 : entryID :=
  { term' := W64 0, index' := W64 0 }

theorem plogTermAt_some_entry (b : entryID) (es : List EntryM) (j t : w64) : PlogWfR b es →
    plogTermAt b es j = some t → uint.Z b.index' < uint.Z j → ∃ e, es[(uint.Z j - uint.Z b.index' -
    1).toNat]? = some e ∧ e.Index' = j ∧ e.Term' = t

theorem preadRespond_eq (id : w64) (s : PState) (q : ReadReq) : ∃ o r, preadRespond id s q = { term
    := s.term, vote := s.vote, lead := s.lead, role := s.role, votes := s.votes, outbox := o, base
    := s.base, log := s.log, commit := s.commit, matched := s.matched, rd := r }

def Role.ofNat : Nat → Role :=
  bif n.ble 0 then Role.follower else bif n.ble 1 then Role.candidate else Role.leader

theorem plog_match_down (b1 : entryID) (es1 : List EntryM) (b2 : entryID) (es2 : List EntryM) (i :
    w64) : PlogWfR b1 es1 → PlogWfR b2 es2 → RecsAgree b1 es1 b2 es2 → (plogTermAt b1 es1 i).isSome
    = true → plogTermAt b1 es1 i = plogTermAt b2 es2 i → ∀ (j : w64), uint.Z b1.index' ≤ uint.Z j →
    uint.Z b2.index' ≤ uint.Z j → uint.Z j ≤ uint.Z i → plogTermAt b1 es1 j = plogTermAt b2 es2 j

theorem plogLastIndexZ_nonneg (b : entryID) (es : List EntryM) : 0 ≤ plogLastIndexZ b es

def readonlyRecvAck (r : ReadOnly) (src : w64) (ctx : List w8) : ReadOnly :=
  if ctx = [] then r
  else
    { pending := r.pending, acks := <[src := w64Max ((r.acks !! src).getD (W64 0)) (leToU64 (List.take 8 ctx))]>r.acks,
      confirmed := r.confirmed }

theorem HbCtxOk_release (r : ReadOnly) (id c : w64) (l : List (MessageM × List EntryM)) (k : Nat) :
    HbCtxOk (readonlyRelease r id c l) (hbCtx (readonlyRelease r id c (List.take k l)))

def pvoteReq (id dst term : w64) (last : entryID) (cl : List w8 := []) : Msg :=
  Msg.mkV MsgType.vote id dst term false last.index' last.term' (W64 0) (W64 0) [] [] cl

theorem firstOcc_append_prefix (a b : List (Option (List w8))) : firstOcc a <+: firstOcc (a ++ b)

theorem pappend.proj_role (s : PState) (es : List EntryM) : (pappend s es).role = s.role

theorem preadRespondAll_eq (id : w64) (s : PState) (qs : List ReadReq) : ∃ o r, preadRespondAll id s
    qs = { term := s.term, vote := s.vote, lead := s.lead, role := s.role, votes := s.votes, outbox
    := o, base := s.base, log := s.log, commit := s.commit, matched := s.matched, rd := r }

theorem FullOk_base0 : FullOk base0 []

theorem plogFindConflict_some (b : entryID) (es ents : List EntryM) : plogFindConflict b es ents ≠
    W64 0 → ∃ d e, ents[d]? = some e ∧ e.Index' = plogFindConflict b es ents ∧ ¬PlogMatches b es
    (entId e) ∧ ∀ (j : Nat) (e' : EntryM), j < d → ents[j]? = some e' → PlogMatches b es (entId e')

theorem full_wf (b : entryID) (fp es : List EntryM) : FullOk b fp → PlogWf b es → PlogWf base0 (fp
    ++ es)

def SnapOk (id : w64) (s : PState) (m : Msg) : Prop :=
  m.ty = MsgType.snap ∧
    m.src = id ∧
      m.term = s.term ∧
        m.dst ≠ id ∧ m.index ≠ W64 0 ∧ uint.Z m.index ≤ uint.Z s.commit ∧ plogTermAt s.base s.log m.index = some m.logterm

theorem stamp_index_eq (L : Int) (k : Nat) : 0 ≤ L → L + 1 + ↑k < 2 ^ 64 → uint.Z (W64 L + W64 1 +
    W64 ↑k) = L + 1 + ↑k

theorem readonlyRecvAck_eq (r : ReadOnly) (src q : w64) : readonlyRecvAck r src (u64Le q) = {
    pending := r.pending, acks := <[src := w64Max ((r.acks !! src).getD (W64 0)) q]>r.acks,
    confirmed := r.confirmed }

theorem padoptLeader.proj_base (s : PState) (src : w64) : (padoptLeader s src).base = s.base

def IsQuorum (cfg q : GSet w64) : Prop :=
  GMap.size cfg < 2 * (q ∩ cfg).size

structure CSLists : Type where
  voters : List w64
  learners : List w64
  outgoing : List w64
  learnersNext : List w64
